'''Pomorie''' ({{langx|bg|Поморие}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[municipality|municipal]] ({{langx|bg|общински, pronounced obshtinski}}) [[association football]] club based in [[Pomorie]], that competes in the [[Regional Amateur Football Groups (Bulgaria)|A RFG Burgas]], the fourth tier of Bulgarian football. The club plays its home matches at the [[Pomorie Stadium]], which has an overall capacity of 2,000 seats."}}
